entities.summary: Miguel Primo de Rivera y Urquijo, 3rd Duke of Primo de Rivera, 5th Marquis of Estella was a Spanish politician, lawyer and businessman. He was a grandchild of the Spanish dictator of the same name. He was mayor of the city of Jerez from 1965 to 1971. He succeeded his uncle as 3rd Duke of Primo de Rivera and passed down the subsidiary title of Marquis of Estella to his son.
